Preceded by the unnerving sound of claws scratching across stone, the esslinter drags itself through the claustrophobic confi nes within 
the deep roots of Sol’Kesh. Th ere are few underwater caves within the Umbrawells that do not host these stalking eels, terrorizing prey 
both above and below the black water. Slithering out of their wet confi nes and dragging themselves along the ground with specialized 
pectoral fi ns, they can catch their prey unawares. Clawing and constricting their long twisting bodies around the struggling creature, 
they pull them back into the water with their vicious claws. Along the coastal caverns, daellash and esslinter fi ght for dominance, both 
attempting to fi ll a similar niche, and before too long, perhaps one species may not survive the competition.

Adaptable Hunter Th e esslinter can only breathe underwater, but 
can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
Undulating Body Th e esslinter has Advantage on Strength checks 
to escape a grapple.
Waterborne Stalker Th e esslinter has Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks made while underwater.
Multiattack Th e esslinter makes two attacks, using its Glass 
Toothed Bite, Goring Beak, and Clawed Fin Rays in any 
combination.
Glass Toothed Bite Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one 
target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Goring Beak Melee Attack Roll:: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 13 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, 
target Medium or larger creature that the esslinter successfully 
hit with its Goring Beak attack. Failure: Target takes 10 (3d6) 
Piercing damage and begins bleeding. At the start of each of its 
turns, the bleeding target takes 3 (1d6) Piercing damage until it 
receives healing and may repeat the save at the end of each of its 
turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Clawed Fin Rays Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the 
Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until this Grapple ends, the 
esslinter cannot use its Clawed Fin Rays on another target. If 
the target is Medium or smaller, the esslinter can swim without 
any diffi culty.
Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Passive Perception 13
Challenge 3 (XP 700; PB 2)
Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When grappling a creature while in melee 
combat.
On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12, the esslinter. Success: Th e 
esslinter Disengages from combat immediately while grappling a 
creature. Swimming to the safety of its tunnels, dragging its prey 
away from combat.
Skills Perception +4, Stealth +4
Resistances Acid
Encountering Preferring the black depths of sunken tunnels, 
seeking out the nests of the esslinter is not only diffi cult, but 
often fatal in the tight confi nes. A Traveler would fi nd it easier 
to lure them out from their bodies of water by making loud 
echoing noises near the water edge, as they prefer their prey 
alive before dragging them down into the depths.
Two dozen grasping pectoral fin-rays, 
tipped with sharpened ends, skitter 
chaotically for purchase, clawing at 
stone or flesh indiscriminately
The eel can reach surprising speeds in 
larger underground lakes as it undulates its 
serpentine body through the still black water 
A long beak-like mouth is sheathed 
in hard scale plating to protect the 
eel as it winds through tight confines, 
as well as puncture deep into flesh
